title: Time Travel is Cheating: Going Live with DeepFund for Real-Time Fund Investment Benchmarking

task.value: A live, real-time benchmark for evaluating LLMs as fund managers, avoiding look-ahead leakage from historical back-testing.
task.quote: we introduce DeepFund, a live fund benchmark tool designed to rigorously evaluate LLM in real-time market conditions.

architecture.value: Single LLM powers a multi-agent workflow: Financial Planner assigns analysts; Analyst Team (Technical, Company News, Policy, Insider, etc.) emits Bullish/Bearish/Neutral signals; Portfolio Manager decides Buy/Sell/Hold with dual memory; built on LangChain with Supabase storage.
architecture.quote: Below, the Multi-Agent Workflow mimics a structured fund management process through three distinct roles: Financial Planner, Analyst Team, and Portfolio Manager. The entire workflow is powered by a single LLM, selected from various providers available in the LLM Factory

data.value: Live data from Alpha Vantage and Yahoo Finance (statements, news, daily trading stats, insider transactions, macro, policy news); daily trading on AAPL, AXP, BAC, KO, CVX with $100,000 initial cash.
data.quote: our experiments target investments in Berkshire Hathaway’s top five holdings as of Q1 2025: Apple (AAPL), American Express (AXP), Bank of America (BAC), Coca-Cola (KO), and Chevron (CVX). Each LLM manages initial cashflow with a total amount of $100,000.

window.value: Live trading March 17 to April 17, 2025, 24 trading days, daily frequency; no training split. Extended appendix run covers all of Q2 2025.
window.quote: The trading period is from March 17 to April 17, 2025, covering 24 trading days with a daily trading frequency.

models.value: GPT-4.1, Llama 4 Scout, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Grok 3 mini Beta, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen2.5-Max, Doubao-1.5-pro, GLM-4-Air; temperature 0.5.
models.quote: We evaluated nine state-of-the-art LLMs from various providers, each with distinct knowledge cutoff dates, to fairly assess their real-time investment performance, as shown in Table 2.

baselines.value: S&P 500 index and a Buy & Hold strategy (portfolio initialized by the LLM on day 1 and held), plus cross-LLM comparison.

headline_result.value: Only Grok 3 mini Beta was profitable: CR +1.1%, SR 0.51, MDD 5.5% over Mar 17–Apr 17, 2025; others lost (e.g., DeepSeek-V3 -5.7%, Doubao -8.1%) vs S&P 500 -6.91%.

costs.value: Transaction fees not modeled; total evaluation cost about $100 (LLM APIs 40%, financial data 40%, cloud database 20%).
costs.quote: The evaluation incurred approximately $100 in total costs (i.e., LLM APIs 40%, financial data 40%, and cloud database 20%, correspondingly).

leakage_controls.value: Live forward testing using only real-time market data published after each model's pretraining cutoff.
leakage_controls.quote: DeepFund connects directly with real-time stock market data – specifically data published after each model’s pretraining cutoff – to ensure fair and leakage-free evaluations.

limitations.value: US stocks only; ignores transaction fees, trading restrictions, hybrid strategies; limited metrics; short evaluation period in a volatile market may skew results.
limitations.quote: Lastly, the evaluation period was short and occurred during a volatile market, which could skew our results toward specific trading approaches.

release.value: Code released on GitHub under MIT license; live interface at deepfund.paradoox.ai.
release.quote: Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DeepFund.
